hero.title: What is a
hero.description: A one-year preparatory program that bridges the gap between your home country's education and German university requirements. Successfully complete it, and you'll have access to universities across Germany.

why.title: Why Studienkolleg?
why.description: Not all foreign qualifications are directly recognized in Germany. Studienkolleg prepares you for success.

bridge.title: Bridge Your Education
bridge.description: Fill the gaps between your home country's education system and German academic standards with focused preparation.

german.title: Master Academic German
german.description: Intensive language training ensures you're ready for lectures, exams, and academic writing in German.

path.title: Guaranteed University Path
path.description: Pass the FSP exam and gain access to universities throughout Germany. Your qualification is recognized nationwide.

courses.title: Choose Your Track
courses.description: Studienkolleg offers 5 specialized courses. Choose based on your intended field of study.

G.description: Prepares for studies in humanities, social sciences, German studies, and arts.
G.examples: History, Philosophy, Law, Journalism, Art History

M.description: For medical, biological, and pharmaceutical degree programs.

T.description: Prepares for technical subjects including engineering and natural sciences.

W.description: For business, economics, and social science degree programs.

S.description: For language studies and programs requiring strong linguistic skills.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: What you need to apply for Studienkolleg admission.

language.title: German Language
items: TestDaF or DSH accepted at higher levels

fsp.title: Feststellungsprüfung (FSP)
fsp.description: At the end of your Studienkolleg journey, you'll take the Feststellungsprüfung — the assessment test that certifies your readiness for German university studies.

tested.title: What's Tested
tested.description: German language proficiency and subject-specific knowledge from your track.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Written exams over several days, plus oral examinations in some subjects.

after.title: After Passing
after.description: Gain access to universities across Germany in your chosen field of study.

cta.title: Ready to Start Your Journey?
cta.description: Explore Studienkollegs across Germany and find the perfect fit for your academic goals.
